macros.name: classMember
macros.doc: In conjunction with \instrPath and \classPath, use \classMember to declare the identity of each member of the class.

macros.name: DeclareCoverPage
macros.doc: A cover page, if declared, is appended to the beginning of the quiz.

macros.name: distrToInstrOff
macros.doc: Allow the instructor to turn off the distribution of the quizzes to himself by using \distrToInstrOff, the default is \distrToInstrOn.

macros.name: distrToStudentsOff
macros.doc: Allow the instructor to turn off the distribution of the quizzes to the students’ folders using \distrToStudentsOff, the default is \distrToStudentsOn.

macros.name: EsH
macros.doc: We fix the width \EsW and the height \EsH of \essayQ using commands, these can be redefined.

macros.name: EsW
macros.doc: We fix the width \EsW and the height \EsH of \essayQ using commands, these can be redefined.

macros.name: flattenOff
macros.doc: The \flattenOn turns on flattening, while \flattenOff turns flattening off.

macros.name: flattenOn
macros.doc: The \flattenOn turns on flattening, while \flattenOff turns flattening off.

macros.name: freezeQuiz
macros.doc: The \freezeQuiz makes all form fields readonly.

macros.name: FullName
macros.doc: The \FullName field uses the calculate event to extract the first and last names and displays them together in one field.

macros.name: inputWebCfg
macros.doc: Place \inputWebCfg in the preamble to input the web.cfg; any \ExecuteOptions commands are ignored.

macros.name: instrAutoSaveOn
macros.doc: \instrAutoSaveOn saves the document; however, if \instrAutoSaveOff is expanded in the preamble, no automatic save is performed.

macros.name: sadQuizzes
macros.doc: The \sadQuizzes command uses the name fields to identify on which page a quiz begins.

macros.name: setInitMag
macros.doc: This command determines the initial magnification.

macros.name: stuAutoCloseOn
macros.doc: This command is obeyed only if \stuAutoSaveOn is in effect. After the student presses the save button (\stuSaveBtn), the document is closed after the student save the document.

macros.name: stuAutoSaveOff
macros.doc: When \stuAutoSaveOff is in effect, the save button does not appear, and the student must press the save button the on Adobe Reader toolbar.

macros.name: stuAutoSaveOn
macros.doc: When expanded in the preamble, a save button will appear (\stuSaveBtn) when the End Quiz control is pressed.

macros.name: thfullnameFmt
macros.doc: The format for the this name field can be changed through the declaration \thfullnameFmt.

macros.name: thQuizHeader
macros.doc: (The command \thQuizHeader just picks up on the *-option, then expands \thQuizHeaderLayout.)

macros.name: thQzHeaderCQ
macros.doc: This is inserted into the center running header for the quiz pages.

macros.name: thQzHeaderCS
macros.doc: This is inserted into the center running header for the solution pages.

macros.name: thQzHeaderR
macros.doc: This is inserted into the right running header for the solution pages.

macros.name: useEndQuizThor
macros.doc: Define \useEndQuizThor to restore the End Quiz control to the action defined in this package.

macros.name: useStuSaveAsDialogOn
macros.doc: When aebTrustedFunctions is defined for AR, we offer two methods for the student to save the document: (1) \useStuSaveAsDialogOff (the default) is the most seamless method, no save-as dialog is offered, the student asked to confirm the save; (2) \useStuSaveAsDialogOn offers the save-as dialog (but streamlined).
